name: Mission San Esteban del Rey
aka: San Estevan del Rey Mission Church

dates.altered: The survey reads an inscription dated 1710 as evidence of a remodelling and suggests a restoration c. 1700 under Padre Antonio Miranda; the church was restored about 1902 and again in 1927 by the Society for the Restoration and Preservation of New Mexico Mission Churches, which restored walls and towers and put a new composition roof on the church.
dates.note: The 1930s survey prints 'Between 1629 and l64?' beside two other datings it cites (1626 from index cards, 1629 from Hallenbeck); the Wikipedia infobox prints 1629-1641; both style nodes give 1641 as the year. Recorded as the survey and infobox agree.

refs.note: The data page's own header prints 'HABS Ho, 36-HH-5' -- the OCR of the 1930s district-numbered form 36-NM-5 -- and the Library's photograph pages print 'Photos from Survey HABS NM-5'. note: Seeded 4 Sep 2026 for the spanish-colonial-american and new-mexico-adobe nodes. Both nodes' exemplar notes say the adobe walls reach nine feet thick; the two extract spans read from the written data state NO wall thickness at all, so the survey is silent on that figure rather than confirming it. The survey does corroborate the nodes' timber-carrying story in its own words.
